text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Something seems a bit off with Fuji Kiseki 
during her warm-up...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... That's strange. My body isn't 
moving the way I want it to...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no... It's nothing! Don't worry about 
it!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Still... maybe I'll take a little break. 
I think I'll feel better once I've 
rested!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki looks exhausted... It might be 
best to reconsider our upcoming schedule.
